name: Gupta Restaurant
why_it_matters: Yuksom's foremost trekker meeting point — Lonely Planet-listed, run by Raj Gupta and family on the main road. Where Goecha La and Dzongri trekkers swap notes over thalis, pizzas, paneer curry and quesadillas.
insider_tip: Trek-day breakfast crowds peak 7-8am; eat by 6.30am or after 9. The pizza is genuinely wood-fired — order it the night before you start the trek as a final non-camp meal.

name: Shangrilla Restaurant (Hotel Tashi Gang)
why_it_matters: In-house restaurant of Hotel Tashi Gang, Yuksom's longest-running heritage hotel. Serves Sikkimese, Indian, Chinese and continental — and is one of the few places in the village with a proper bar stocked with tongba (warm millet beer in a bamboo flask) and chang.
insider_tip: Non-residents are welcome but call ahead for dinner — kitchen sizes order to occupancy. The tongba is the signature post-trek warm-up; ask them to top it with hot water as you sip down.
signature_address: Hotel Tashi Gang, Yuksom 737113, West Sikkim
